lines.t: (Intro)
(Heavy grand piano chords ringing out over low, dark string swells and a steady 808 kick drum)
(Verse 1 - Deliberate, Deep & Authoritative Flow)
Before the clock began to tick, I held the timeline in My hand
Before the oceans knew their shores, I laid the foundation of the land
I am the Alpha, the Omega, First and Last, the Great I am
The Creator of the galaxy, the Shepherd and the Sacrificial Lamb
You ask for proof, you look for signs, you say you’re searching for a light
While billions of My burning stars are breaking through your darkest night
I carved My signature in stone, in every atom, every breath
I wrote the story of your life and paved the path to conquer death
You act like I am distant, like I’m hidden out of reach—
When My glory fills the atmosphere and speaks in every wave upon the beach!
(Pre-Chorus - Strings Swell, Beat Drops Heavy)
You’re without excuse, it’s written in the sky and on the ground
There is no corner of the earth where My presence can’t be found...
(Chorus - Cinematic Power & High Intensity)
How do you not know Me when My love was on open display?!
I didn't whisper from a mountain, I came down and took the pain!
Look at the cross, look at the nails, look at the blood upon the wood—
I traded My own royalty to give you everything I could!
I spoke it clearly in My Book, I left the truth upon the page
From Genesis to Revelation, timeless through every single age!
You stand without excuse... My love is clear to see.
(Verse 2 - Intense Storytelling, Heavy Delivery)
I didn't leave you in the dark to guess or wander in the fog
I gave My holy Word to you, the living breath of God
Page by page, line by line, I laid My heart out in the ink
To reach the deep, broken places where you didn't think I’d think
And when the prophecies were full, I stepped down into human flesh
To bear the weight of every sin, the guilt, the shame, the heavy mess
Love wasn't quiet, wasn't hidden, wasn't tucked away in pride—
It was stretched across a wooden beam, arms open wide until I died!
I tore the veil, I broke the grave, I rose to give you brand new life—
I bought the Church, I cleared the debt, and called you My intended Bride!
(Bridge - Music Strips to Solo Piano and Deep Sub-Bass)
(Deliberate, solemn delivery)
I spoke through creation...
I spoke through the pages...
And then I spoke through My blood.
What more could I have done to prove My love?
(Chorus - Full Orchestral & Drum Peak)
How do you not know Me when My love was on open display?!
I didn't whisper from a mountain, I came down and took the pain!
Look at the cross, look at the nails, look at the blood upon the wood—
I traded My own royalty to give you everything I could!
I spoke it clearly in My Book, I left the truth upon the page
From Genesis to Revelation, timeless through every single age!
You stand without excuse... My love is clear to see.
(Outro - Fading Grand Piano and Strings)
The sky declares it.
The Book reveals it.
The cross sealed it.
You are without excuse...
Come home to Me.
